title: Quality Studio run persistence
summary: Decision-ready storage design for durable Quality Studio review runs. The recommendation keeps the tested, Git-ignored .quality/runs recovery journal and adds a tracked folder-per-run archive under .quality/run-history. It preserves run plans, immutable stopped attempts, operation results, finding observations, typed verdicts and timestamps; extends the existing token ledger with operation IDs; defines deterministic history and two-run diff APIs; and supplies five implementation slices with acceptance criteria and a non-fabricating migration path.
